verdict.rationale: vLLM's first-party docs directly claim efficient multi-LoRA support for dense and MoE layers, which matches the story's core of serving multiple LoRA adapters on a base model. The support rests on a single one-line feature claim with no further detail. Missing for 10: documentation of how adapters are loaded and served alongside the base model (e.g., per-request adapter selection, dynamic loading, adapter limits), performance evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model

citations.quote: Efficient multi-LoRA support for dense and MoE layers
